title: Inbox Keeper
blurb: Every email is a penalty kick into the zone of its right answer, and each keeper dives to the zone it chose: phishing, spam or safe.
lesson: Sorting short texts into a few clear options is Jev's home ground: it saves as many kicks as the LLMs, faster and for a fraction of the cost.
why: Each email is one Choice question with three options and a sentence that says what each one means. Jev returns the option it picked with a confidence, in a fixed format, so a mail filter can act on it straight away.
The ball always flies into the zone of the right answer, so a save means the keeper chose right. Watch the clock too: Jev's keeper often finishes every kick before the LLM's first dive.
